bphs-97:santhanam:ch24:v79.citation: BPHS · Santhanam 97-chapter edition · Ch. 24 · Sloka 79 · PDF page 46 · bphs-97:santhanam:ch24:v79
bphs-97:santhanam:ch24:v79.context_before: the native will beget a sickly wife and he will be inimical to her. He will be given to anger and will be devoid of happiness.

bphs-97:santhanam:ch24:v80.exact_text: 80. If Yuvati’s Lord is in Randhr Bhava, the native will be deprived of marital happiness. His wife will be troubled by diseases, be devoid of good disposition and will not obey the native.
